text.config.enchantingfixes.title: Enchanting Fixes Config
text.config.enchantingfixes.option.prote: Applies only when the Scaling Enchantments data pack is on. In vanilla, protection enchantments decrease damage by a maximum of 80%. With the pack, protection above that point decreases damage more, but each level adds less. The decrease gets closer to this limit, but does not reach it. 80 keeps the vanilla limit. The server config controls this value.
text.config.enchantingfixes.option.maxLe: The maximum level of each enchantment in the list. Write one entry on each line as enchantment_id=level, for example minecraft:sharpness=10. The level must be from 1 to 255. By default, the list has each vanilla enchantment with more than one level at level 10, or at its hard cap if that is lower. The list has Advanced Silk Touch at level 30. These entries always apply, including to single-level enchantments. Some enchantments have a hard cap, for example Lure V. Above the cap, a higher level gives no more benefit or breaks the enchantment. Saving removes lines that are not in this form.
text.config.enchantingfixes.option.rando: The maximum level of random enchantments from chest loot, villager trades, piglin bartering, the enchanting table, and mob equipment. The anvil and /enchant always use the maximum level above. Off: the vanilla maximum level. Balanced: up to 2 levels above the vanilla maximum level, for example Sharpness VII. Insane: any level up to the maximum level above. The server config controls this value.
text.config.enchantingfixes.option.useDe: Off: enchantments that are not in the list keep their usual maximum level. On: they use the default maximum level.
text.config.enchantingfixes.option.defau: The maximum level of the enchantments that are not in the list. Applies only when Use Default Maximum Level is on. A value lower than the usual maximum level decreases the maximum level.

Single-level enchantments have a usual maximum level of 1, for example Silk Touch and Mending. Off: they stay at level 1. On: they also use the default maximum level. Most of them do the same thing at all levels. Aqua Affinity and Multishot become stronger at higher levels.

text.config.enchantingfixes.option.remov: In vanilla, the anvil refuses each change that costs 40 levels or more, except in creative mode. On: the anvil has no limit. You must still have the levels to pay the cost. A stack of more than one item keeps the limit. The server config controls this value.

On: you can put enchantments that work correctly together on the same item. Examples: all the protection enchantments, Sharpness with Smite, Infinity with Mending, Multishot with Piercing, and Depth Strider with Frost Walker. Silk Touch and Fortune stay incompatible. Riptide stays incompatible with Loyalty and Channeling. Incompatibilities from other mods and data packs do not change. The server config controls this value.
